name: Heavenly Nail Spa
address: 4222 El Camino Real, Palo Alto, CA 94306

reviews.author: Annie Chao
reviews.text: Came in on a busy Saturday hoping the salon would somehow have availability for a manicure AND nail art AND a pedicure, and I was so grateful they got me squeezed in. Daisy absolutely delivered.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: I came here as a walk-in today and was able to get squeezed in an hour later. The shop is small, but very efficient and very clean, and everyone is very welcoming.

reviews.author: Carina
reviews.text: This was my first time coming here and I have never been to a nail salon with such a professional atmosphere. The experience was super nice and chill, and Helen was extremely precise with every line.

reviews.author: Katya Lapina
reviews.text: We had the best experience at Heavenly Nail Spa! Three of us came to treat ourselves for my mom's birthday and had the most incredible, friendly, professional service. Loved our mani pedis.

reviews.author: Rachel Chinta
reviews.text: Wow, this nail spa is simply amazing. If you ever want to feel pampered and feel beautiful you must visit these ladies. They are kind, loving and so professional.

reviews.author: Kassaundra Tillman
reviews.text: This is a beautiful relaxing environment with lovely sweet staff. From the moment I entered they were so welcoming, offering water, coffee and a snack. Beautiful nail art.
